comments.text: No-op: terminal.ex already uses Registry.dispatch/3 at line 325. All remaining Registry.lookup calls in the TUI app are point lookups, not fan-out dispatch patterns.

description:
Same Registry.lookup-then-iterate pattern in OctoPi.TUI.Events — wherever Terminal broadcasts stdin_chunk and resize events to registered listeners. Apply the same Registry.dispatch/3 idiom for atomicity.

Audit all Registry.lookup calls in octo_pi_tui and replace with Registry.dispatch/3 where the pattern applies.
title: Registry.dispatch/3 for TUI Events fan-out
